_doc: COMPLETION PASS 13 — the ONE datum the attestation faculty cannot derive structurally. A documentation author marks status in a frontmatter block-sequence ENUM (MDN `status:` = deprecated/experimental/non-standard; the attestation faculty DISCOVERS that enum by SHAPE, never by name). But which enum VALUE means PROHIBITION ('no longer use this') is not a structural fact — every value renders an invariant, subject-varying banner, so structure alone cannot tell the deprecation banner from the experimental one (the measured PASS 11/12 wall). That single choice lives here as DATA, exactly as sources.json carries the doc sources. No banner text, no site, no element, no English — only the author's own enum value(s) that denote prohibition. Language expansion adds its markers' values here (Rust `deprecated`, Python `deprecated`). PASS 22 — `removed` is the second such datum: the token that, PAIRED with a prohibition token in one class value (`deprecated-removed`), denotes REMOVAL — the strongest prohibition status, a WHOLE-MODULE marker distinct from an inline per-method `versionmodified deprecated` note (the PASS-21 precision line, measured: the tight compound matches 29 pages and admits exactly the removed python modules, while a loose `deprecated` substring floods 2812 and contaminates the subject basis). Consumed ONLY by the construction miner's removal-subject basis (`lint_attest::attests_module_removal`); the page-role attestation (`attests`, `prohibition_class_tokens`) is UNTOUCHED, so every existing module is byte-identical.
_doc_pass28: COMPLETION PASS 28 — the NOTE-SCOPE register vocabulary, the third and fourth such data. A rendered deprecation note's OWN sentence can narrow its scope in author English no structural signal supplies: `scope_exception` tokens introduce an exception list (an item named AFTER one is EXCLUDED from the deprecation — 'All TLSVersion members except TLSVersion.TLSv1_3 are deprecated'); `usage_form` tokens, as bounded words in the FIRST SENTENCE of the clause after the deprecation head, mark an argument/call-form deprecation ('Deprecation warning is emitted if loop …', 'Passing/Setting/Accepting … is deprecated') that deprecates a USAGE, not the item. Consumed only by the rendered-route item attestation (`lint_lang_layer::attested_item_shapes`) as counter-attestation; measured on python-library: 1/1 exception + 13/13 usage-form correct cuts, zero true deprecations lost (LINTER.md PASS 28).
